notes: kb/Work/PB452.md LANDED 2026-09-09. FLOAT-INFINITY stores the ISO/IEC 60559:2020 Clause 3 canonical infinity of the receiver's basic interchange format, with GR33's sign. SR32 confines the receiver to a STANDARD floating-point usage (3.166/3.167) and the two WiseOwl COBOL provides map EXACTLY onto binary32 (FLOAT-BINARY-32 -> float) and binary64 (FLOAT-BINARY-64 -> double), so the carrier IS the interchange format and nothing is approximated; the other three standard usages are Annex A.3 items 17/19 documented non-support, refused at declaration.
